text:
HTTP::passthrough_reason
Description
This command returns the reason for the most recent switch to
pass-through mode by the HTTP filter.
Syntax
HTTP
::
passthrough_reason
[
<
as_num
>
]
HTTP::passthrough_reason
Returns a string with one of the following values:
Unknown
iRule
Connect
Web Sockets
Oversize Client Headers
Excess Client Headers
Oversize Server Headers
Excess Server Headers
Unknown Method
Pipelined Data
HTTP::passthrough_reason
[<as_num>]
Returns an integer code corresponding to which case in the above list
occurred, suitable for an error code.
Examples
when
HTTP_DISABLED
{
log
local2.
[
HTTP
::
passthrough_reason
]
}
when
HTTP_DISABLED
{
log
local2.
[
HTTP
::
passthrough_reason
as_num
]
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
Any HTTP event, or an event where the http filter is initialized
